subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler/ouvir e compreender, com autonomia, relatos de observações e de pesquisas em fontes de informações, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender independentemente relatórios de observação considerando a situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Read and independently comprehend observation reports considering the communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Read grade 6–8 science and technical texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender independentemente relatórios de pesquisa extraídos de fontes informativas
components.description_en: Read and independently comprehend research reports drawn from informational sources
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend grade 6–8 literary nonfiction texts independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Identificar o tema principal e detalhes-chave em um texto informativo
components.description_en: Identify the main topic and key details in an informational text
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main topic and key details in an informational text

components.description_pt: Distinguir detalhes relevantes de informações complementares em relatórios de pesquisa lidos independentemente
components.description_en: Distinguish relevant details from supporting information in independently read research reports
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between relevant and irrelevant supporting information for a given topic

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts (with prompting and support) by
* Identifying main topic and key details
* Asking and answering questions about descriptions of familiar attributes and characteristics
* Identifying word choices in relation to topic content area
By the end of the year, read and comprehend literary nonfiction in the grades 6—8 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.
By the end of grade 8, read and comprehend science/technical texts in the grades 6—8 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
Develop the topic with relevant facts, definitions, concrete details, quotations, or other information and examples.
